faqs.q: Which teams reach the Quarter-final rounds?
faqs.a: The top 8 teams, based on the Memorial selection round, will compete in the Quarter-final rounds.

faqs.q: Where can we find the proposition and rules?
faqs.a: The competition rulebook is available in the Resources section. The moot proposition will be published there by the organising committee when available.

faqs.q: Are the dates and deadlines final?
faqs.a: Please refer to the latest official competition communication for any revisions to the schedule.
